meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties to accelerate drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly evaluate ADMET and toxicity properties for many molecules

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 DeepChem 处理分子数据(SMILES、SDF、蛋白质序列),转为指纹、图等特征,训练传统或图神经网络模型,预测溶解度、毒性等属性,并可调用 MoleculeNet 基准数据集和预训练模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理分子数据(如 SMILES、SDF、蛋白质序列),预测分子属性(溶解度、毒性等),或想用 MoleculeNet 基准、预训练模型做实验时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude can use DeepChem to handle molecular data (SMILES, SDF, proteins), featurize (fingerprints, graphs), train ML or GNN models, predict properties (solubility, toxicity), and use MoleculeNet datasets and pretrained models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to process molecular data (SMILES, SDF, proteins), predict properties (solubility, toxicity), or use MoleculeNet benchmarks and pretrained models.

say_en.text: Train a graph neural network with DeepChem to predict toxicity on Tox21.
say_en.note: Loads MoleculeNet benchmark and trains a GCN model.

say_en.text: Help me predict molecular solubility from a CSV file using DeepChem.
say_en.note: Reads CSV, computes features, trains or predicts.

say_en.text: Fine-tune a ChemBERTa pretrained model on my small dataset with DeepChem.
say_en.note: Loads the pretrained model and fine-tunes on your data.
